units: <cite ref="Tosefta Kilaim 5:11">Tosef. Kil. V, 11</cite> <he>המְזַוֵּיג את הכלאים</he> he who harnesses together two heterogeneous animals; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 90b">B. Mets. 90ᵇ</cite> <he>המְזַ׳ בכל׳</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 3:2:2">Y. Gitt. III, 44ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>הגע עצמך שזִיוֵּוג</he> but supposed that one matched it, i.e. found a letter of divorce just containing the names of the persons under consideration (though not written for that special transaction).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 3:2:2">Ib.</cite> <he>כיון שאינו מצוי לזַוֵּוג אפי׳ ז׳ כמי שלא ז׳</he> since it is so rare to find such a matching combination, even if one did, we consider it as if he had not done it, i.e. such rare chances are not taken into consideration.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 5:3:3">Y. Shek. V, 49ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>הגע … שז׳ אותו היום</he> supposed somebody produced a ticket with the mark of the same day of the week?—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 5:3:3">Ib.</cite> <he>אפי׳ לזויג וכ׳</he> (read as above: <he>כיון שאינו וכ׳</he>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 1:8:2">Y. M. Kat. I, end, 80ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>מְזַוֵּוג את האומריות</he> one who knots the fringes two by two (instead of making a regular network).—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 5:1:16">Y. Shek. V, 48ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>מְזַיֵּיג את הפתילות</he> (Bab. ed. <he>מְזַוֵּוג</he>) he adjusted the length of the wicks (to the length of the time they had to burn); Y. Yoma II, 39ᵈ bot.—Esp.
<cite ref="Sotah 2a:8">Sot. 2ᵃ</cite> <he>אין מְזַוְּוגִין לו לאדם וכ׳</he> a wife is selected (in heaven) for each man according to his deserts.
<cite ref="Sotah 2a:8">Ib.</cite> <he>קשין לזַיְּוגָן וכ׳</he> to wed couples is as difficult as the splitting of the Red Sea.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 68">Gen. R. s. 68</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 8:3">Lev. R. s. 8</cite>, beg. <he>מְזַוֵּוג זִיוּוּגִים וכ׳</he> He joins couples, decrees who should be married to whom.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 8:3">Ib.</cite> <he>אני יכולה לזַיְּוגָם וכ׳</he> I can couple them in one hour.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 8:3">Ib.</cite> <he>זווגן בלילה וכ׳</he> (read: <he>זִוְּוגָתָן</he>); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to join in a hostile sense, to attack.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:6:3">Cant. R. to III, 6</cite>, v. <cite ref="L00039"><he>לָבַב</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to match in misery, to comfort by pointing out a similar case (cmp.
units: <cite ref="Lamentations 2:13">Lam. II, 13</cite>).
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 30:1">Pesik. R. s. 30</cite> <he>מזדווג בה וכ׳</he> (read <he>מְזַוֵּוג לה</he>) He shows her (the country) a fellow-sufferer to comfort her.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 30:1">Ib.</cite> <he>מזדווג לה אלכסנדריה וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.) he pointed out to her Alexandria.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 30:1">Ib.</cite> <he>בא יואל וזי׳ לה</he> Joel came and comforted her (by pointing to the Lord’s sympathy).

senses.gloss: to be joined; to join, meet. Y. Yoma VI, 43ᶜ top שיִזְדַּוֵּוג לו חבירו that the other bullock must be joined to him (they must belong to the same couple).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 5:5">Snh. V, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Sanhedrin 40a:11">40ᵃ</cite>) <he>מִזְדַּוְּוגִין זוגות וכ׳</he> they met in couples (for consultation). Y. Taan. I, 64ᵃ top (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 21:11">Is. XXI, 11</cite>, play on <cite ref="A01835"><he>אֵלַי</he></cite>) <he>אֶלִי מאיכן נז׳ לי וכ׳</he> whence did my God join me again? From Seir (Rome); a. fr.

senses.gloss: (in a hostile sense) to join in battle, attack.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1">Ex. R. s. 1</cite>; Tanḥ. Sh’moth 5 <he>בוא ונִזְדַּוֵּוג וכ׳</he> come and let us plan how to get at that nation.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 11">Lev. R. s. 11</cite> <he>נִזְדַּוְּוגוּ לו שלשה וכ׳</he> three enemies attacked it jointly.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 11">Ib.</cite> <he>באו ברבריים נ׳ לו</he> barbarians attacked him; Esth. R. introd.; a. fr.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:4">Cant. R. to I, 4</cite> <he>(נגילה</he>); Pesik. Sos, p. 147ᵃ <he>כשם שנִזְדַוַּוגְתֶּם וכ׳</he> as you have been married with festivities.
